code_blocks.code:
bun test --isolate ./tests
bun test --parallel ./tests
bun test --parallel=8 ./tests
code_blocks.purpose: Run each test file in a fresh global environment (--isolate) or distribute across N worker processes (--parallel).
code_blocks.notes: Available in bun test. Could adopt --parallel for CI to speed up 2451 tests.

code_blocks.code:
bun test --shard=1/3
bun test --shard=2/3
bun test --shard=3/3
code_blocks.purpose: Split test files across multiple CI runners. Round-robin distribution, 1-based index.
code_blocks.notes: Could adopt for CI parallelization. Composes with --changed and --randomize.

code_blocks.code:
bun test --changed
bun test --changed=HEAD~1
bun test --changed --watch
code_blocks.purpose: Only run test files affected by git changes. Builds import graph, filters transitively.
code_blocks.notes: Could adopt for faster local dev iteration. Composes with --watch.

code_blocks.feature: bun install streams tarballs to disk
code_blocks.purpose: Extracts tarballs while downloading instead of buffering in memory. Enabled by default.
code_blocks.notes: AUTOMATIC — no code change. Benefits all bun install runs.

code_blocks.feature: Faster bun install with isolated linker
code_blocks.purpose: 8.5x faster installs in peer-heavy monorepos (20.5s → 2.4s). Byte-identical output.
code_blocks.notes: Could adopt --linker=isolated in bunfig.toml for monorepo installs.

code_blocks.feature: Source maps use up to 8x less memory
code_blocks.purpose: Bit-packed binary source map format. ~2.4 bytes/mapping vs 20 bytes. Zero decode on first access.
code_blocks.notes: AUTOMATIC — no code change. Benefits error stack traces and bun build --compile.

code_blocks.purpose: mimalloc v2→v3 upgrade, libpas scavenger for Windows & Linux. Reclaims memory faster.
code_blocks.notes: AUTOMATIC — no code change. Fixes hangs/crashes in long-running processes.

code_blocks.purpose: 1316 upstream commits. IC for array.length, toUpperCase intrinsic, SIMD string comparisons.
270 upstream WebKit commits. File streaming on SSL/Windows, range request support.
code_blocks.notes: AUTOMATIC. Range requests benefit Bun.serve file responses.

code_blocks.code:
const res = await fetch("http://localhost:3000/video.mp4", { headers: { Range: "bytes=0-1023" } });
// res.status === 206
code_blocks.purpose: Automatic Range: bytes= handling for file-backed responses. 206 Partial Content, 416 for invalid.
code_blocks.notes: AUTOMATIC — benefits Bun.file() responses in src/server.ts. Suffix, open-ended, and RFC 9110 ranges supported.

code_blocks.purpose: zlib-ng 2.3.3 replaces Cloudflare zlib fork. SIMD acceleration for CRC32, Adler32, longest-match.
code_blocks.notes: AUTOMATIC — no code change. Benefits node:zlib, fetch decompression.

code_blocks.feature: Faster array iteration in Bun internals
code_blocks.purpose: 1.43x faster array iteration for Int32/Contiguous storage. Reads directly from JSC butterfly.
code_blocks.notes: AUTOMATIC — benefits expect().toContain(), Blob construction, etc.

code_blocks.feature: SHA3 support in WebCrypto and node:crypto
code_blocks.purpose: SHA3-224, SHA3-256, SHA3-384, SHA3-512 in crypto.createHash, createHmac, subtle.digest, subtle.sign/verify.
code_blocks.notes: Available for use. Could adopt for audit log hashing if needed.

code_blocks.purpose: X25519 key agreement via crypto.subtle.deriveBits(). RFC 7748 §6.1 small-order rejection.
code_blocks.notes: Available for use. Could adopt for E2E encryption if needed.
